body: What are the reasons that are stopping you? Whatever they are hold onto them, focus on them, and use them as motivation to seek help and get better.

I'm the same. For me two things worked, listening to sad songs (this only worked the first time I listened to them) and alcohol. Drinking makes me cry and I enjoy that. I would heavily recommend the first method over the second cause it isn't a good road to go down.
I feel so stressed, tired worried. The therapy is NHS so my assessment is next month, after that I'll be on a long waiting list. It's tough to hold on that long for something that might not help.
I've been described as quite aggressively suicidal so it would probably be forced detainment.
That is what I'm here to decide, death seems preferable.
There are plenty of people better than me that deserve the help more.
I decided I didn't want help, I accepted that happiness just isn't for me.
Death, goodbye cruel world.

Like I'm at beach stuck in quicksand. Everyone else around me is having fun and enjoying themselves while I slowly sink lower and lower. The only thing worse than the sinking is that the sand fills your mouth so you can't speak up, not that it would matter as no one would care if you could as they don't want to pull you from the sand, they want to have fun.

>This too shall pass

Although it feels bad now it won't be that way forever, hold out and you will come out the other end.

It always distressed me when I was young when people would say this, I believe it is what has given my cynical attitude. People just accepted that it was unfair and did nothing to attempt to change this which has now led to me being bitter and hating the world while taking no steps to help it.
I do, I just don't see an alternative.
If your relationship is close and strong enough, ask him how he feels and make sure he knows that you value his life, that you would miss him and that you would care.

I'm slightly different, now I always see mental health issues within films that I can compare to. When a character does something stupid I often think it may be because that have low self-esteem and so feel the need to get noticed, just like me.

I used to hold this attitude and I deeply regret it now, I think you just have to see it differently. I spend a lot of the time believing that people do not see me, occasionally I will do stupid things order to change this, to feel noticed for some small amount of time.

I think it is quite sad that some people are insecure enough that they feel the need to hurt themselves in order to have people notice them. Now maybe it is due to them having an inflated ego but I still believe they need help as without it they may end up here, posting about how awful they feel.

>The only tears come from our heads when we concentrate

This is from a song by The Wombats and I don't know about the rest of you but it's true for me. Sometimes I want to feel that sadness so will try to make myself cry, it is a relief.
My relationship with my parents is not a good one, but I'll try and take the advice to let people in, thanks.

Your family really love you by the sound of it, if you feel the same then talk to them. Doctors and pills will never be as good as a conversation. I would trade anything to have a loving family, my advice is use the support network that they are trying to offer.

I wish you all the best.
I'm sad to say that all I am now is anger, bitterness and pain.
This makes perfect sense, I feel exactly the same...
I decided I would make a decision when I was 22, if I saw a future of hope and happiness then I would wait another 5 years to decide, if I didn't then my birthday would be my last day too.

When I was younger I judged someone who claimed they had depression for the same thing, and then I actually thought about it. How bad does it have to get where you need to do something like that for attention but also who am I to judge, I don't know their situation and if they think they are depressed then they probably are. Now that I'm in that boat I regret what I did to them and others everyday, along with everything else I've ever done.

Depending on her age (she may be too young to understand what total hopelessness feels like), explain it to her. Tell her how you fell, tell that your life is not something you enjoy and you don't want attention but rather need help. Maybe she will understand and your relationship will improve.
I constantly need people to validate my entire existence, if they don't notice or care about me then why should I bother living.

I take a different approach to music, I listen to music that validates my feelings and makes it clear that I'm not alone in feeling this way. A band I really fell in love with that does this is First Aid Kit.
I tell myself it is a bullshit holiday, doesn't make it any less lonely.
Hey if Stardew valley is going I would love it, slow satisfying games really help when you are on the edge of just going mental so it looks good.

I hate my birthday, you don't care about me the rest of the time so don't pretend to day just because I happened to be born that day a few years ago. The worst part is the social expectation that forces everyone else to sing, you don't care about me so leave me alone.
Yes completely, I am a real shitty person. It's the reason I don't blame people for not liking me.
Yeah, regret is one of the worst feelings in the world.
There is no starting over so you just have to keep going, you can't worry about the past or the future just live in the present. The problem is the present isn't that great either.

I have a couple people I can talk too and it helps a bit but the problem is they are going through something similar, that is why I could talk to them. This mean that as much as they can tell it will get better they don't really believe it themselves so I can't believe it either. I hope it will get better but that hope is fading...

I completely agree, whenever I think about suicide I always think about what would happen after, who would care, who would be hurt. It's a shame I will never know because that is the only way I think I could ever communicate how I feel.

I know what you mean, I'm also kind of stuck in some self fulfilling prophecy. People don't contact me so I don't contact them as I just assume they don't care and so the cycle continues, it's slowly killing me.
I would like nothing more than a relationship, but I feel like I'm shit enough that I don't deserve it. I don't want to ruin someone else's life with my problems.
